firstDevice.title: Add your first device
firstDevice.text: A light, plug, sensor or radiator valve. It appears on Home straight away, so you can control it with one tap.

welcome.title: Your everyday lights go here
welcome.text: Press and hold a light or plug and choose “Show on Home”. Then you can control it with one tap, as soon as you open the app.

pairing.title: Add a device

instructions.light: Turn the light on and off 5 times, one second each time.
instructions.switch: Hold the button on the plug for 5 seconds.
instructions.sensor: Press the button with a paperclip until the little light blinks.
instructions.climate: Hold the button on the radiator valve until the pairing symbol flashes. The manual says how long.
instructions.hue: Press the button on your Hue Bridge.

pairing.mayTakeAWhile: It can take a moment to appear in the list.
pairing.unsupported: We don’t know this device yet. We’ve disconnected it again.

notSeen.climate: I don’t see my radiator valve

help.title: What you can try
help.power: Check that the device has power, or a full battery.
help.closer: Move it closer to your Sandhovius box, or to a light or plug that always has power.
help.restart: Switch it off and on again, and wait a minute.
help.reset: Reset it to factory settings. The manual says how.
